cases.source:
<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class DynamicScalar141 {}
$source = new DynamicScalar141;
$source->alpha = 7;
$source->beta = 9;
echo "S:";
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
$copy = clone $source;
echo "C:";
foreach ($copy as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
$copy->alpha = 11;
unset($source->beta);
$copy->gamma = 13;
echo "A:", $source->alpha, "/", $copy->alpha, "|";
echo "R:";
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
echo "K:";
foreach ($copy as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
echo "Z|";

<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class DynamicAlias141 {}
$single = new DynamicAlias141;
$seed = 7;
$single->value =& $seed;
unset($seed);
foreach ($single as $key => $value) { echo "S:", $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
$singleCopy = clone $single;
$singleCopy->value = 11;
echo "single:", $single->value, "/", $singleCopy->value, "|";
$held = new DynamicAlias141;
$seed2 = 17;
$held->value =& $seed2;
$outside =& $seed2;
foreach ($held as $key => $value) { echo "H:", $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
$heldCopy = clone $held;
$heldCopy->value = 19;
echo "held:", $held->value, "/", $heldCopy->value, "/", $outside, "|Z|";

<?php
class Payload141 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "P|"; }
}
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class DynamicPayload141 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
$source = new DynamicPayload141;
$source->item = new Payload141;
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "F:", $key, "|"; }
unset($key, $value);
$copy = clone $source;
echo $source !== $copy && $source->item === $copy->item ? "shared|" : "bad|";
unset($source);
echo "middle|";
unset($copy);
echo "Z|";

<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class DynamicCallback141 {
    public function __clone(): void {
        echo "C|";
        foreach ($this as $key => $value) { echo "in:", $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
        $this->alpha = 11;
        unset($this->beta);
        $this->gamma = 13;
    }
}
$source = new DynamicCallback141;
$source->alpha = 7;
$source->beta = 9;
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "pre:", $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
$copy = clone $source;
echo "source:";
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
echo "copy:";
foreach ($copy as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
echo "Z|";

<?php
class PayloadThrow141 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "P|"; }
}
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class DynamicThrow141 {
    public function __clone(): void {
        global $failure;
        echo "C|";
        throw $failure;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
$failure = new Exception("supplied");
$source = new DynamicThrow141;
$source->item = new PayloadThrow141;
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "F:", $key, "|"; }
unset($key, $value);
try { $copy = clone $source; echo "bad-copy|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo $caught === $failure ? "same|" : "bad-error|"; }
echo isset($copy) ? "bad-set|" : "no-copy|";
unset($source);
echo "Z|";

<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class EmptyDynamic141 {}
$source = new EmptyDynamic141;
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "bad-entry|"; }
$copy = clone $source;
echo $source !== $copy ? "fresh|" : "bad-identity|";
foreach ($copy as $key => $value) { echo "bad-copy-entry|"; }
$copy->later = 7;
echo isset($source->later) ? "bad-shared|" : "independent|";
echo $copy->later === 7 ? "copy7|Z|" : "bad-copy|";

<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class UncachedDynamic141 {}
$source = new UncachedDynamic141;
$source->value = 7;
$copy = clone $source;
$copy->value = 11;
echo $source->value === 7 && $copy->value === 11 ? "separate|Z|" : "bad|";

<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class DeclaredDynamic141 { public $fixed = 3; }
$source = new DeclaredDynamic141;
$source->extra = 7;
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "pre:", $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
$copy = clone $source;
$copy->fixed = 5;
$copy->extra = 11;
echo $source->fixed, "/", $source->extra, "/", $copy->fixed, "/", $copy->extra, "|Z|";
